note: Lincoln County park on the west edge of Lake Benton just off US 14, about 800 acres of woodland and prairie in a coteau valley, with hiking trails, playground and shelters. Camping is in separate loops on both sides of US 14. Seasonal campers are also taken. No ATVs, UTVs or dirt bikes in county parks. --Claude
summary: County parks page read: 33 sites all with electric and water, dump station, chalet with showers, $30 electric (undated, current page); seasonal camping offered May 1-Oct 15. Booking (phone reservations) and the stored season are not stated by the county; left in place. Not waterfront kept.
flags: FEES date: the county rate list is undated (the page is live 2026-11-11 and links the 2024 master plan; the price-research read on 2026-10-15 saw the same figures). Reviewer may treat the $30 as current or as undated.

LONG-STAY: the county sells seasonal camping at this park (May 1 - October 15, $1,500 with electric and water; 'Hole-in-the-Mountain Horse Hill $1400'). The seasonal share of the 33 sites is not published. Google Maps 4.5 (111 reviews). The county posts nightly rates; nothing discourages nightly guests. Not a drop candidate on the pages read.
BOOKING reservable:true (derived from old note prose) is not stated on any county page; only aggregators (Campendium) say reservations are taken, by phone to 507-368-9350. Left in place, unverified.

SEASON 05-15..10-31 (derived, 'Approximate') is not stated by the county; the only county dates are the seasonal-lease period May 1 - October 15. Left in place; reviewer may prefer 05-01..10-15 on that statement.
max_rig_ft 33 (derived) is not on the county pages; left in place. Electric amperage not stated by the county (aggregators disagree, 20 vs 30 A).

SITE MAP: the county map shows numbered sites in three groups: 1-20 by the chalet west of Russell L. Zimmer road south of US 14 (about 44.2646,-96.3034, the stored pin area), 1-12 east of that road, and a loop of paired A/B sites (1A-15B) north of US 14. The north A/B loop may be the 'Horse Hill' horse camp priced separately; the county does not say. Not a split: all share one park entrance road off US 14 and are under 1 km apart.
WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: no lake or river at the camping areas on the county's aerial site map; Lake Benton (the lake) lies about 1.5 km east beyond the town.
Phone 507-368-9350 confirmed on the county page (Lincoln County Parks). Website confirmed. Pin 44.26461,-96.30338 sits on the chalet-side sites; no move.
